body_text:
Hi Swati,

Please check the animation text. If it’s starting with “Happy Independence
Day” and then moving to “Wishing your business growth and success,” it
reads like two unrelated wishes instead of a connected thought.

For better storytelling, it should open with the business-focused message
first - “Wishing your business growth and success” - so that it feels
relevant to merchants, and then wrap it up with the festive greeting “Happy
Independence Day” for an emotional finish.

body:
Hi Swati,

Please check the animation text. If it’s starting with “Happy Independence Day” and then moving to “Wishing your business growth and success,” it reads like two unrelated wishes instead of a connected thought.
For better storytelling, it should open with the business-focused message first - “Wishing your business growth and success” - so that it feels relevant to merchants, and then wrap it up with the festive greeting “Happy Independence Day” for an emotional finish.
Additionally share the WhatsApp gif creative in same theme and format 

@Zeeshan Ekram Please QC it and help us with WhatsApp text copy.


Regards,

Harish Chaduvula,
